<0>Ease out for things that respond to you.</0> Elements entering, expanding or following a click start fast and settle, so the interface feels immediate.
<0>Reduced motion is a second design, not an off switch.</0> Movement turns into instant changes or plain fades, and state stays readable.
<0>Short and interruptible.</0> Most motion is 150 to 300ms. Anything that can be reversed starts from where it is now rather than restarting.
